title: Secondary Storage Availability Limiter & Explicit Mass Flux Contract

mass_sign_convention.equation: S1-S0 = dt*(q_drain_secondary + q_rapid + q_supply - q_discharge) + V_top_surface_exchange
mass_sign_convention.q_drain_secondary: positive soil/drainage system to secondary surface water; negative secondary surface water to soil
mass_sign_convention.q_supply: positive external supply into secondary surface water
mass_sign_convention.q_discharge: positive external discharge out of secondary surface water
mass_sign_convention.V_top_surface_exchange: positive into secondary surface water; negative from secondary surface water to soil surface

inputs: committed or trial-start secondary storage S0
requested signed secondary per-level exchange rates q_i
resolved physically available external supply capacity q_supply_available >= 0
pre_solver_limiter_contract.inactive_branch: if Smax >= 0, alpha=1 and all requested q_i pass unchanged
pre_solver_limiter_contract.active_branch: if Smax < 0, q_limited_total = -(S0/dt + q_supply_available), alpha=q_limited_total/q_req, and reference-semantics scale every secondary q_i by the same alpha
pre_solver_limiter_contract.algebraic_precondition_consequence: with S0>=0, dt>0 and q_supply_available>=0, an active limiter implies q_req<0 and 0<alpha<1
output: assumed available supply capacity used for the envelope

critical_supply_capacity_rule.required_input: resolved supply capacity actually enabled for this physical interval by the applicable control state/policy
critical_supply_capacity_rule.reason: frozen drainflux_extended always uses WSCAP in the pre-limiter, while WLEVBAL can later set WSMAX=0 when the supply target is at/below the deepest secondary bottom
critical_supply_capacity_rule.owner_of_supply_enablement: later fixed/automatic control component, not the D3 limiter

explicit_actual_flux_contract.supply_constraints: 0 <= q_supply <= q_supply_available for an accepted trial
explicit_actual_flux_contract.accepted_mass_ledger: runtime books exactly the physical fluxes and amount used in the accepted storage update, once and only once
explicit_actual_flux_contract.rejected_trial: no supply, discharge, drainage or top-surface mass from a rejected trial is booked

dry_floor_contract.dry_state: S1=0 only if explicit accepted fluxes close exactly to that state
dry_floor_contract.acceptance: accept only when 0 <= q_supply_required <= q_supply_available; otherwise the physical trial must be recomposed/retried/limited rather than creating water
dry_floor_contract.positive_near_zero_projection: may be mapped to S1=0 only by reducing actual q_supply so exact mass closure is preserved and supply remains within capacity

mixed_sign_reference_semantics.legacy_behavior: when limiter activates, one alpha scales every secondary q_i, including any positive drainage contributors
mixed_sign_reference_semantics.scientific_issue: positive local inflows are reduced even though the shortage arises from net infiltration
mixed_sign_reference_semantics.recommended_initial_candidate_domain: limiter-active cases with all secondary q_i <= 0
mixed_sign_reference_semantics.future_route: either independently qualify exact all-level proportional legacy scaling as intended physics or define a separately qualified remediated allocation rule

source_risks.hold: do not feed raw WSCAP directly; supply availability must be physically resolved for the interval
the frozen -0.1 cm tolerated negative projection cannot be an accepted unmatched mass residual
actual q_supply must be a first-class result and accepted-ledger term
initial production route should exclude limiter-active mixed-sign secondary exchanges pending scientific disposition
pre-solver limiter cannot certify final storage because q_rapid and top-surface exchange enter later
if exact dry-floor closure requires q_supply above available capacity, trial must not be accepted
limiter only transforms trial exchange; runtime alone books accepted transfer and external supply/discharge

cross_child_boundaries.F-PM08D1: owns storage geometry and SWST/WLS relation
cross_child_boundaries.F-PM08D2: owns restricted constitutive per-level exchange law before availability limiting
cross_child_boundaries.F-PM08D4: will own fixed-weir storage/discharge evolution and supply-target logic
cross_child_boundaries.F-PM08D5: will own automatic-management target/control memory and event logic
cross_child_boundaries.F-PM08D6: will own transactional ordering, final acceptance and committed mass ledger

hard_holds: No production source modification in F-PM08D3 readiness.
No physical mass residual tolerance or water creation/destruction concession.
No raw WSCAP assumption where control disables supply.
No committed mass booking inside the limiter.
No mixed-sign limiter-active production admission without separate scientific qualification.
No fixed/automatic weir implementation in D3.
No calendar or file-I/O dependency in the limiter contract.
